set.body:
Owner: fit/profile. Acceptance:
- For d<=3 enumerate feasible box faces/stationary candidates with singular-face, indefinite-curvature, boundary, tie and nonlinear-admission handling; include prior with correct signs.
- Compare reference cells using score values in consistent coordinates; separate data curvature and prior curvature. Emit weak identification/prior dominance/ambiguity/budget statuses.
- Original-model approximation checks use certified or explicitly empirical bounds; coefficient residual acceptance alone cannot certify shape accuracy.
- Independently searched dense nonlinear oracle assesses frozen cohort, boundaries and failures; no cherry-picking accepted cases or optimizer-local minima.
- JVM+JS tests demonstrate deterministic reference routing and bounded work.
Performance: <=8 bank references per geometry, <=2 evaluated references per voxel, no unlimited recentering/shape optimization. Target local-cohort admission/decoder accuracy as specified on epic; failed budgets return status.

Specification: docs/plans/profile-hrf.md (SHA256 bb6b56efab0d251b287ec0d315112103c2213434a489625def8c2ccc9b35293c). Research probe: tools/validation/profile_hrf_review.py (SHA256 03be9eab54b76c0076ced2fe4deb26ab00fe4259536284833ae53971a5a61c9d). These are local review artifacts, not a released estimator. The source proposal numerical tables were unavailable; only independently reproduced checks count as evidence.
set.title: PHRF-09: Implement bounded reference bank and constrained observed-Hessian decoder
